new_processes.name: Counterparty name correction on deals
new_processes.definition: Changing deals booked under an invalid or wrong counterparty entity so they are booked and confirmed under the correct entity.

new_processes.name: Campus recruiting outreach
new_processes.definition: Arranging visits and outreach to university groups to promote career and internship opportunities.

new_processes.name: Customer hedge and structure pricing quotes
new_processes.definition: Receiving customer requests for hedges or structured deals and pricing and following up with quotes.

new_processes.name: Meter data verification
new_processes.definition: Verifying meter master data such as state and county information against schedulers' records.

new_processes.name: Storage and delivery point set-up
new_processes.definition: Setting up deferred delivery points in systems after new storage points are approved by tariff filing.

new_processes.name: Vacancy and head count approval
new_processes.definition: Justifying and approving replacement hires and additional head count through sign-offs.

new_processes.name: Time off scheduling
new_processes.definition: Staff requesting vacation or personal days and managers approving them around month-end settlement needs.

batch_notes: No injection attempts found. Several personal or noise messages given empty processes. Seven new keys proposed, mostly single-message processes.
